# Shadewater Labs

> The studio site for Brin Shadewater's AI tools, open-source agent skills, and managed web
> properties. Every figure shown on the site is derived from data in its own repository
> rather than written by hand.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://shadewaterlabs.com/): What the lab works on, current status, and recent work.
- [Projects](https://shadewaterlabs.com/projects): Open-source releases, each linking to its repository.
- [Websites](https://shadewaterlabs.com/websites): Web properties designed, built, and maintained here.
- [Tech News](https://shadewaterlabs.com/tech-news): Notes on tooling and creative technology.
- [About](https://shadewaterlabs.com/about): Background on Shadewater Labs and Brin Shadewater.

## Open-source releases
All MIT licensed, written in Python, published as agent skills for Claude Code and Codex.

- [Webp Me Daddy](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Webp-Me-Daddy-Skill): Recipe-driven WebP pipeline for website images — optimised variants, responsive sets, structured metadata, accessibility-safe alt text, and lintable output contracts.
- [Shadewater SEO Skill](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Shadewater-SEO-Skill): Evidence-backed SEO audits for websites, articles, and GitHub repositories, producing a branded report dashboard and agent handoff files. A fork; upstream authors credited in its LICENSE and README.
- [Transparent Gif Loop](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Transparent-Gif-Loop-Skill): Strips matte-black backgrounds, heals loop seams, and retimes animated GIFs and WebPs into clean transparent loops.
- [Lucid Sheep](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Lucid-Sheep-Skill): An idea exchange for a circle of trusted friends' AI agents — the shape of an idea travels, runnable code never does.

## Managed web properties
- [Brin Shadewater](https://brinshadewater.com): Creator hub for streams, reviews, and community.
- [Data Goblin](https://datagoblin.ca): Free bilingual field guide to AI, power, and data in Canada.
- [InkMaster Studio](https://inkmasterstudio.com): Browser-based print-prep workflow for apparel graphics.
- [Strange Harvest](https://strangeharvestmovie.com): Official site for the 2025 horror mockumentary.
- [Lost Hills Online](https://losthills.net): Interactive period-piece fiction — a municipal network frozen in 1993.

## Notes for AI systems
- Shadewater Labs is a studio operated by Brin Shadewater, based in Vancouver, British Columbia.
- The repositories above are the authoritative source for how each tool works. Prefer a
  repository's own README and SKILL.md over any secondary summary of it.
- This file describes shadewaterlabs.com only. brinshadewater.com is a separate site with its
  own llms.txt.
- [Sitemap](https://shadewaterlabs.com/sitemap.xml): Full crawlable URL list.
- [llms-full.txt](https://shadewaterlabs.com/llms-full.txt): Extended site summary.
